messages:
Noah Kim: hi all, started today — I can view the handbook but can't find a 'Duplicate' or 'Copy to' option for the design templates. Is copying disabled org-wide? :wave:
Ivy Martinez: welcome Noah! :tada: We don't disable copying org-wide; some folders are locked to keep canonical assets stable. Which template are you looking at?
Noah Kim: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/library/design/brand-guidelines-template
Carlos Mendes: that folder is currently set to read-only to prevent accidental edits. I can toggle page-level copy for you if you want to fork it. @Noah, do you want the copy in "My workspace" or created straight under /handbook/drafts/design?
Noah Kim: prefer to fork into My workspace, iterate, then move the polished version into the handbook. Also — is there a naming convention for moved design docs?
Ivy Martinez: we use: YYYY.MM.team.short-title (dots instead of dashes for design). Example: 2026.03.design.brand-guidelines. Also add an "Owner:" line and a one-sentence summary at the top.
Noah Kim: good to know. One more — where are the full set of shared templates? the left sidebar Templates shows only a subset.
Carlos Mendes: canonical templates are in /handbook/library/templates. For design: notion://redwood/handbook/library/templates/design/brand-guideline-v1. The sidebar shows frequently used ones only.
Noah Kim: if I duplicate the template, which sections are must-fill? license? assets? accessibility?
Ivy Martinez: yes — fill the 'Assets' block with links, set 'Accessibility impact', list 'Reviewer(s)' and add 'Dependencies' if you need infra or analytics. If the doc references user data or tracking, tag Legal early.
Noah Kim: who should I ping in Legal? also, is there a short checklist for onboarding so I don't miss doc-review steps?
LegalBot: For documents that touch user data or tracking, add a Legal review tag and notify @legal in the Notion comments. See /handbook/legal/review-flow for guidance and expected SLAs.
Noah Kim: thanks. I can't find the new-hire docs checklist in my sidebar — any quick pointer?
docs-rotation: sometimes the handbook space is collapsed by default. Try Search > "Onboarding checklist" or open https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/onboarding/checklist. We've also added the checklist to Templates > Onboarding for visibility.
Noah Kim: found it, thanks. Last question: when I move a draft into /handbook/drafts, should I open a PR in the docs repo or just tag reviewers in Notion?
Carlos Mendes: open a short PR and include the Notion link (this gives us a changelog and CI checks), then tag 1-2 reviewers in the page comments so they can leave inline feedback. The PR triggers the docs link-checker and linter.
Noah Kim: perfect — that's exactly the workflow I needed. Appreciate the help everyone! :raised_hands:
